items.text: I’d like to add a section for my own personal health/fitness. Include a portion where I can enter specific workout routines that will be saved and able to scroll through/select/add to days like I do with the recipe and weekly menu section. Also track my postpartum timeline with recommendations regarding activity based on that timeline (examples including weekly recommended frequency and duration of walking, recommended stretches, exercises, etc). After 12 weeks postpartum, I also want a tracker for my cycle, if able to connect to my Oura ring app-the info can be pulled from there, if not, then I can enter it manually or just press a button for cycle start. This can also track my activity and sleep details from the Oura ring if able to connect to it.
items.author: Mackie
